scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:auth && npm run build:downloader && npm run build:server && npm run build:descriptor
scripts.build:auth: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w auth
scripts.build:downloader: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w downloader
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build:app
scripts.build:descriptor: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w descriptor
scripts.start: npm run start:auth && npm run start:downloader && npm run start:server
scripts.start:auth: npm run build:auth && systemctl --user start video-auth.service
scripts.start:downloader: npm run build:downloader && systemctl --user start video-downloader.service
scripts.start:server: npm run build:server && systemctl --user start video-server.service
scripts.restart: npm run restart:auth && npm run restart:server
scripts.restart:auth: npm run build:auth && systemctl --user restart video-auth.service
scripts.restart:downloader: npm run build:downloader && systemctl --user restart video-downloader.service
scripts.restart:server: npm run build:server && systemctl --user restart video-server.service
scripts.fix-playlists: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && node --no-warnings scripts/fix-historical-playlists.mjs
